mechanism: Denosumab inhibits osteoclast activity and bone resorption, necessitating adequate calcium supplementation to prevent hypocalcemia and maintain bone mineral homeostasis.
action: Ensure adequate calcium intake (1000-1200 mg daily) and vitamin D supplementation concurrent with denosumab therapy; monitor serum calcium levels periodically, especially in patients with renal impairment or predisposing hypocalcemia risk factors.
